patterns.evidence: member_id holds only the ObjectId of a member document; no member details such as name or email are copied into the loan, so they must be looked up in members.
book_id holds only the ObjectId of a book document; the loan carries no copy of the book's title, author or ISBN, which live only in books.
subjects is a short list of plain strings describing the book's topics (for example "Gardening"), a multi-valued attribute of the book rather than identifiers or sub-documents.
notification_channels is a small list of plain string values from a fixed set such as "email" or "sms", recording the member's contact preferences as a multi-valued attribute.
